question: Where can I get livestock numbers and agricultural residues by municipality in Spain, by species or crop and year?

answer.summary: INE publishes 2020 municipal livestock tables; Navarra also lists annual municipal census workbooks, including 2025. Direct workbook extraction could not be tested. Provincial reports estimate crop residues by municipality; national annual crop-specific residue coverage remains unverified.
main_caveats: 2020 livestock date is 30 September; results are not live animal registers.
Municipal census cells can be suppressed and records swapped for confidentiality.
Biomass estimates depend on assumptions and do not establish actual collected residue.
answer.confidence_reason: INE data extraction and most regional sources could not be tested; municipal crop/year residue coverage remains unresolved.

national_registry.note: 2020 INE national census tables cover livestock, with thresholds and confidentiality; this does not cover municipal crop-residue time series.

recipe: In the Aragón PDF find the livestock table, transcribe municipality, type and Cabezas, and record 2020 as the census year.
For the IDAE sample read page 58 and transcribe Santaella total residue estimate; page 59 reports crop areas, not residue tonnes. These examples do not fill national annual gaps.
In the Burgos report table 101, transcribe each municipality and crop production value; avoid adjacent area columns and preserve empty cells. Underlying year remains unverified.
In the Granada diagnosis page 206, match municipality column to crop-category and potential or available dry biomass row. Dates of input data were not established.
if_unstructured.location_method: Use the municipality name in the document; no facility coordinates are implied.
